text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper explicitly focused on national-scale spatial land use prediction for China from 2000 to 2050. The study integrates a national integrated assessment model (T21-China) with a spatial land use model (CLUMondo) to simulate land system changes under three distinct future policy scenarios, including quantitative comparison among scenarios. The paper reports spatially explicit land system maps, quantitative accuracy metrics (Kappa statistic = 0.84), and detailed land-use intensity classes. The primary objective is clearly land use land cover prediction/simulation, with mapped projections and scenario-based analysis at the entire country scale. It meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria. Although the paper also estimates terrestrial ecosystem carbon storage changes, this is secondary to the LULC prediction focus. Therefore, it is categorized as OK.)
